page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, full width. No marginal notes. A vertical bracket mark stands in the left margin beside the lines "prosessionis" to "purgatorij", but it carries no text.

main_text.p: præfati negabant hæretici, in spiritu fortitudinis Dei intrepidè confessus est. Et ex vera illa confes-sione, vera Christi ecclesia renouari denuò cœpit, & eius regnum subinde maiores accipere uires: Anti-christi uero statim confici, et ad interitum perduci.

Ex Christiano Massaeo: Anno Domini 1515 Frācifcus[?] Gallorum rex accepit à Leone Iubileum (venales indulgentias) diuulgandum per Gallias: qui & alia (Angliam in primis) Christiani orbis climata occupauit. Abyssus malorum. Nam sub umbra professionis in Turcas inæstimabiles thesauros collegerunt. Quorum conflatores & commissarij qui-dam, persuaserunt turbis, ut quicunque daret io solidos, liberaret animam pro qua daret, à poenis purgatorij. Nam pro regula certa tenebant, Dominum Deum facere quicquid ipsi uellent, secundum illud: Quicquid soluerit super terram, &c. Quod si uel iota minimum fuisset quàm io solidi, nihil prodesse concionati sunt. Displicebat hic quaestus sanctis Ecclesiæ filiis. Accepit quaestio ventilari de potestate vicarij: & unde hæc nouissima prælatis doctrina noua, quam prisci pontifices ignorassent? Erat tunc in Germania Martinus Luther, qui nimis acriter inuectus est in has indulgentias. Opposuit se illi Ioannes Eckius: uicissimq; bi[?] duo suggestum conscen-derunt, coram populo contentiosissimè disputan-tes.

page.notes: Printed text is in a single column, so no margin notes were transcribed. The vertical bracket mark in the left margin is typographic, not a note. The underlined passages are rendered as italic. "Frā" ends a line and "cifcus" begins the next, with no visible hyphen; the joined form "Frācifcus" is uncertain. "bi" before "duo" is doubtful, possibly an abbreviation for "bini". "io" (for ten) is printed as shown. Long s is transcribed as plain s and "f" as printed in "fuper" and "foluerit" is read as "super" and "soluerit", since the long s resembles f on the scan.
